intent: Allow mobile users to work offline and sync later.
assumptions: Illustrative human-authored proposal, not approved behavior.
A single authenticated owner controls each record; server revisions are authoritative.
acceptance_criteria: An owner can read cached records and queue edits without connectivity; queued edits survive restart.
On reconnection, retry queued edits without duplicate application and reject edits by another owner.
Detect concurrent revisions and retain both edits for explicit owner conflict resolution; never silently overwrite.
After successful conflict-free synchronization, mobile and server expose the same revision.
